description: This file is a shell script used to test various git merge scenarios involving the recursive merge strategy, specifically testing the 'ours' and 'theirs' options. It automates git commands to verify behavior under different merge conditions, including conflicts, attribute settings, pull operations, and symbolic link handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success execution.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that is expected to fail.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Records changes to the repository with a message.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Switches branches or restores working tree files.

methods.name: git merge
methods.description: Joins two or more development histories together.

methods.name: git diff
methods.description: Shows changes between commits, commit and working tree, etc.

methods.name: git pull
methods.description: Fetches from and integrates with another repository or branch.

methods.name: git reset
methods.description: Resets current HEAD to a specified state.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
